email.subject: Gearhead Co's site is likely losing you calls
email.body:
Ben,

Quick check of Gearhead Co's site: it's not mobile-friendly and there's no click-to-call button. For an auto shop, most searches and calls happen from a phone when someone's stranded or needs a quick repair — if they can't tap to call in two seconds, they call the next shop.

Also worth fixing: no reviews shown, slow-loading images, and a page title that doesn't say what you do or where you're located, which hurts how you show up in local searches.

I fix stuff like this for a flat fee. Want a free 10-minute walkthrough of what's costing you the most?

Alex
Northlight Web
